testCases.label: Verify replace_characters replaces substrings correctly
testCases.description: Ensures replace_characters returns the string with all occurrences of the target substring replaced by the new substring.

testCases.label: Verify split_string splits by delimiter
testCases.description: Checks that split_string correctly splits input strings using the specified delimiter.

testCases.label: Verify join_strings joins elements with delimiter
testCases.description: Ensures join_strings concatenates list elements using the provided separator.

testCases.label: Verify count_occurrences counts substring occurrences
testCases.description: Checks that count_occurrences correctly counts both single-character and multi-character substrings.

testCases.label: Verify find_char_index returns index of substring
testCases.description: Ensures find_char_index returns the index of the first occurrence of the substring, or -1 if not found.

testCases.label: Verify starts_with_substring matches prefix
testCases.description: Checks that starts_with_substring returns True when the string begins with the given substring and False otherwise.

testCases.label: Verify ends_with_substring matches suffix
testCases.description: Ensures ends_with_substring returns True only when the string ends with the provided substring.
